newsitem.title: EGYPT: Qatari minister in Egypt for Suez Canal LNG talks.
newsitem.headline: Qatari minister in Egypt for Suez Canal LNG talks.

text.p: Qatari Energy and Industry Minister Abdullah bin Hamad al-Attiyah arrived in Cairo on Friday for a short visit to Egypt, airport sources said.

The chairman of the Suez Canal Authority, Ahmed Fadel, was quoted on Thursday as saying that he and Attiyah would sign on Monday an agreement to reduce canal transit fees for Qatari exports of liquified natural gas (LNG) to Europe.
The international Arabic-language newspaper al-Hayat said the discount would be five to 10 percent if Qatar sends between three and four million tonnes of gas a year through the canal.
This would be on top of the 35 percent discount which Egypt has already offered Qatar, it added. The agreement will cover the period from January 1998 to the end of 2001, it said.
Suez Canal officials were not available to comment because of the Islamic weekend.
